page_notes: Bibliographic additions and source list only; no numbered lexical-entry segments occur on this page. The page opens with Songs = M. B. Emeneau, Toda Songs (Oxford, 1971), then lists sources by language and the corresponding DED/DEDS headings: Kannada (Ka.)—DED §21 (including D. N. S. Bhat, Barkur, Gowda, Jenu Kuruba, Rabakavi, Sholiga, Tiptur, Hal., Gul., and Nanj.); Kodagu (Kod.)—DED §22 (Kar. and MBE 1970); Tulu (Tu.)—DED §23 (B-K and D. N. S. Bhat); Telugu (Te.)—DED §24 (K. Mahadeva Sastri); Gadba (Ga.)—DED §§28–9; and Gondi (Go.)—DED §30. The facing column defines DGG and its Adilabad (A Su.) and Koya (Koya Su.) dialect labels, plus Koya T.; records PSS 1970; and lists Konda—DED §31, Pengo—DEDS §31a, and Brahui (Br.)—DED §36 with Krishnamurti 1969. It then gives sources for the provisionally new languages Betta Kuruba (Kurub.), Belari (Bel.), and Koraga (Kor.), followed by other works on Dravidian linguistics—DED §37 (Annamalai and Burrow 1968).
